name: PASCAL VOC
description: A widely used dataset and annual challenge for object classification, detection, and segmentation on natural images.
evaluation_method: mean Average Precision (mAP) for detection (commonly at IoU=0.5), mean IoU for segmentation, per-class accuracy for classification
typical_sota_score: approximately 85–95% mAP on common VOC detection splits for modern detectors (varies by year/split and model)
notes: Relatively small compared with newer datasets (e.g., COCO); many tasks are well-studied and nearing saturation for state-of-the-art detectors. High risk of pretraining/data contamination for large pretrained vision models; widely used, classic vision benchmark rather than an LLM benchmark.
